items.title: Kabir Maharjan discharged after surviving 10 days trapped inside hydropower tunnel
items.summary: Kathmandu, September 25 Kabir Maharjan, the mechanical supervisor who was rescued alive after spending 10 days trapped inside a tunnel at the Upper Trishuli 3-A Hydropower Project in Rasuwa, has been discharged from hospital. items.summary: Kathmandu, September 25 Students who lost their parents or homes in the Rasuwa floods are being accommodated at schools so they can continue their education. items.title: Shah returns from UNGA after putting climate crisis at centre of Nepal’s global pitch
items.summary: Nepal’s prime minister highlighted the Bhotekoshi floods, climate justice and Himalayan risks at the UN General Assembly, while seeking greater international support for resilience and reconstruction.

items.title: A month on, Nepal flood victims remain missing as hope and posters fade
items.summary: Relatives plastered hospital walls in Kathmandu with notices searching for loved ones swept away by the Bhotekoshi floods. With thousands still unaccounted for, many families have turned to symbolic last rites.
